operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Creates a follow-up status.

This is a v2 native-entity endpoint served from the `/v2/api/entity` base and authenticated with a Bearer token. Send a flat JSON object whose keys are the fields below; `name`, `status`, and `staff_id` are required and any unknown key is ignored.

On success the id of the new status is returned.

item_type.description:
The module/record type this status applies to. Optional — the API does not restrict this field: any integer is accepted, and it defaults to `0` when omitted.

Known values (informational):

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 1 | Client Type |
| 2 | Invoice Type |
| 3 | Estimate Type |
| 4 | PO Type |
| 5 | Staff Type |
| 6 | Supplier Type |
| 7 | Product Type |
| 8 | Work Order Type |
| 9 | Appointment Type |
| 10 | Shift Type |
| 11 | Booking Type |
| 12 | Product Tracking Type |

color.description: Optional. A display color for the status as a hex value (e.g. `#ff0000`). Stored as an empty string if omitted.

status.description:
The status stage. Defaults to `1` (Open). Send an integer — other values are stored incorrectly.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 1 | Open |
| 2 | Closed |

staff_id.description: Required. Id of the staff member the status belongs to. If omitted the request fails with a `400`.

entity_key.description: Optional. Free-text key linking the status to a specific workflow or module entity (for example a workflow entity key). Not restricted to a fixed set.

display_order.description: Optional. Controls the display order of the status.

id.description: Id of the newly created status.

400.description: The record passed validation but could not be saved — for example a required related field such as `staff_id` was not supplied.

error.description: Human-readable reason the record could not be saved.

422.description: A required field (`name` and/or `status`) was missing or empty.

errors.description: Per-field validation messages. A key is present only for a field that failed. Required fields: `name`, `status`.
